limits: Valid owned consistent trees, stable ordering, and callbacks that do not mutate topology, keys or private defaults.
New source APIs; original STL/CRT/FH3 ABI, private-stack aliases, malformed storage and hardware faults are unvalidated.
Controller tree-copy helpers are implemented only along the freshly constructed empty-default path reached by map indexing; general populated copy is not provided.
Sensitivity scalar and upper preset flag bytes are explicit preimages of native uninitialized stack bytes. Opaque words remain untouched.
Separate 14-method keyboard library, application wiring and game validation remain.
